# Routen Woods — A Cabinet Company

> Professional cabinet refacing, repainting, customization, repair, and custom closet services in Oxford, Michigan and surrounding areas. Family-owned, 15+ years experience, 1,000+ projects completed.

## About

Routen Woods is a family-owned cabinet company based in Oxford, Michigan. We specialize in transforming kitchens without full renovations — most refacing projects are completed within a week. We are fully licensed and insured.

**Service area:** Oxford, Lake Orion, Auburn Hills, Rochester, Clarkston, Orion Township, and surrounding communities in southeast Michigan.

**Contact:** (813) 270-2180 | Mon–Fri 8am–5pm, Sat 8am–12pm

## Services

### Cabinet Refacing
Replace your old doors with new 3DL or wood cabinet doors and drawer fronts, and new laminate frames and finished ends on your existing cabinets. A complete kitchen transformation at a fraction of the cost and time of a full rebuild.

- [Cabinet Refacing](https://www.routenwoods.com/services/cabinet-refacing)

### Cabinet Repainting
Professional stripping, prep, and refinishing of your existing hardwood cabinet doors. Doors are removed, taken to our paint shop, stripped to bare wood, and refinished in your chosen color. Typically 7–10 business days. Not available for every kitchen — some materials can't be painted properly.

- [Cabinet Repainting](https://www.routenwoods.com/services/cabinet-repainting)

### Customization, Repair & Accessories
Repair damaged or broken cabinets. Modify existing cabinets for new appliances or build custom for your space. Add roll-out trays, drawers, trash pull-outs, spice racks, and more.

- [Customization, Repair & Accessories](https://www.routenwoods.com/services/cabinet-customization-and-repair)

### Custom Closets & Pantries
Closet and pantry systems designed, built, and installed — tailored to your space and needs.

- [Custom Closets & Pantries](https://www.routenwoods.com/services/custom-closets-and-pantries)

## How It Works

1. **Free Consultation** — We visit your home, assess your cabinets, and discuss your vision. No pressure, no obligation.
2. **Expert Preparation** — Meticulous measuring, surface preparation, and applying high-quality laminate to cabinet boxes. Wide variety of door styles available.
3. **The Transformation** — New doors and drawer fronts installed, cabinet boxes relaminated to match. Most jobs completed within a week.
4. **The Big Reveal** — Final walkthrough, quality inspection. We don't leave until you love it.

## FAQ

- **How long does cabinet refacing take?** Most projects are completed within a week.
- **What's the difference between refacing and replacing?** Refacing keeps your existing cabinet boxes and replaces doors, drawer fronts, and surface finish — new look at a fraction of the cost and time.
- **What door styles do you offer?** 3DL, 5-piece profile-wrapped, and melamine — from contemporary slabs to ornate raised panels to simple shakers.
- **What areas do you serve?** Oxford, Michigan and surrounding areas including Lake Orion, Auburn Hills, Rochester, and Clarkston.
- **Do you offer free estimates?** Yes — free, no-obligation in-home consultations with a detailed quote.
